reminders.title: Water break
reminders.message: A few sips now. Your future brain says thanks.

reminders.title: Unfold yourself
reminders.message: Stand up, reach high, and loosen your shoulders.

reminders.title: Snack check
reminders.message: If you're hungry, grab something that will keep you going.

reminders.title: Take a tiny lap
reminders.message: Walk around the room. The code can breathe for a minute.

reminders.title: Look somewhere far away
reminders.message: Give your eyes twenty seconds off the screen.

reminders.title: Maybe you need a nap
reminders.message: If focus keeps slipping, a short reset may beat another push.
